converts LFQData object to SummarizedExperiment

Source: R/LFQData.R
LFQDataToSummarizedExperiment.Rd

For compatibility with Bioconductor

Usage

LFQDataToSummarizedExperiment(lfqdata)

Arguments

lfqdata

LFQData object

Value

SummarizedExperiment (bioconductor)

See also

Other LFQData: AggregateLimpa, AggregateMedpolish, AggregateRlm, AggregateTopN, LFQData, LFQDataPlotter, LFQDataStats, LFQDataSummariser

Examples


istar <- prolfqua::sim_lfq_data_peptide_config()
#> creating sampleName from file_name column
#> completing cases
#> completing cases done
#> setup done
data <- istar$data
lfqdata <- LFQData$new(data, istar$config)
lfqdata$data_wide()
